story: Seven riders broke away early, but the peloton limited their lead to 2.5 minutes. Approaching the local circuit, the gap was under one minute. In the final lap, the breakaway was caught and attacks began with 30 km remaining. Jonas Abrahamsen briefly broke free on the last climb but was caught in the final kilometer. Jasper Philipsen won the sprint and secured the overall Baloise Belgium Tour victory.
